rationale: Price action and fundamental catalysts are in direct conflict: the stock gapped down nearly 6% on a significant Q3 earnings and revenue miss alongside a weak broader market, yet intraday order flow is strong with price holding well above VWAP ($12.61) near the top of its session range ($12.76 vs $12.84 high). Shorting here fights persistent upward momentum and higher 1-minute lows, while going long chases an extended move into overhead resistance against a bearish fundamental catalyst.
